Based on other comments, this brings to mind a very common phrase in Elite Dangerous: Don't fly, without rebuy.

Now I don't know the costs for SC as I've not seen clips on the new sys yet.

In Elite, it's a percentage (%) of the total value of the ship hull, plus components you have put in.
You can see this cost at anytime on one of the right side panel windows and or while in the outfitter. 

Hopefully CIG find a decent way to handle this, might be wishful thinking considering historically thats been rough lol.
